Dr Maureen Martinson

General pPractitioner                                                                                       Commented [OETONLIN1]: Capitalise all words when
                                                                                                            addressing someone by their professional title.
Tambo Medical Centre

18 Tamborine Drive

Mt Tamborine QLD



Dear Dr Martinson,

Re: Mr Kenneth Phillips, DOB: 05/05/1974



Thank you for accepting Mr Phillips into your care, who requires your ongoing support following a           Commented [OETONLIN2]: Keep the pronoun as close as
bilateral lung transplant due to a history of interstitial lung disease.                                    possible to the noun it represents.
                                                                                                            “Thank you for accepting Mr Phillips into your care for ongoing
                                                                                                            support…”
                                                                                                            “Thank you for accepting Mr Phillips, who requires ongoing
On 10/01/2020, Mr Phillips was admitted for his surgery after which he was transferred to our               support…”

Rehabilitation Ward five days later. After his operation, he used nebulizer 2L, his oxygen saturation was
99% and refused to stop oxygen. He had a stage two painful pressure ulcer in the coccyx for which it        Commented [OETONLIN3]: Article required for countable
requires 2 Nd daily dressing, a pressure relief mattress, cushion and regular Panadol. He was able to       noun “ulcer” and when specifying a type: “a stage two painful
                                                                                                            pressure ulcer”.
walk with a four-wheel walker for 20 meters with shortness of breath after which he used a single point
                                                                                                            Commented [OETONLIN4]: As above
stick without shortness of breath.



Two weeks later, Mr Phillips agreed to reduce the nebulizer to 1L and to be discharged to home without
oxygen since his oxygen saturation was 97%. He was educated about home oxygen and started self-
medicating with supervision. Today, his room air oxygen saturation was 94%, he can mobilize without         Commented [OETONLIN5]: As this is a compound sentence,
aids and self-medicate well under supervision. The coccyx wound needs dressing every second day after       subject “he” required as omitting it means the second clause
                                                                                                            inherits the subject “his” from the first clause.
his discharge as he will be discharged on 01/03/2020.



He is divorced, works as a builder and lives alone as his son lives away from home. He will be moving to    Commented [OETONLIN6]: Location required as this is slightly
Mt Tamborine to live with his sister, who is a nurse, and has offered to help with his wound dressing and   vague. Lives away from where?
medication. Kindly note, a list of medications is enclosed.                                                 Commented [OETONLIN7]: No comma required as including it
                                                                                                            implies that the subject is Mr Phillips.
                                                                                                            Commented [OETONLINE8]: Plural preferred in this context

Your continuous care will be greatly appreciated. If you require any further clarification, please do not
hesitate to contact me.
 
Yours sincerely,

Doctor

 Comments          Good work Hawazen and this is strong in nearly all categories, as you can
                   see in the table above. Really good summary of the case with good
                   contextual detail regarding his sister. The only concern is the slightly high
                   number of errors (7 total).
                   Focus on:
                      - Placement of relative pronouns
                      - Articles
                      - Compound sentences
